title: Choose Hermes's visual world
question: The roll assigned Field Radio. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Comps show the chat screen mid-turn.

options.label: Field Radio
options.lineage: rugged two-way radio handsets: reflective LCD, channel knob, push-to-talk
options.thesis: Hermes is crew working out in the field; your phone is the handset that talks to it.
options.viewport: A reflective-LCD status band (channel number, session name, live state word, timer, link bars) over a transcript set as a radio log with YOU / HERMES callsigns; a wide orange talk bar anchors the bottom under the composer.
options.risk: Tips into costume if the radio is drawn literally; it must stay Material components themed in this grammar, never a picture of a handset.

raised.raise: The tool timeline is a strict hairline-ruled log: packed rows, no padding inflation.
One reversed plate per screen, reserved for whatever needs you: a pending approval or question.
Every tool row carries its running time, right-aligned tight against the margin.
Sessions carry stable channel numbers (CH 01, CH 02…) as their index identity.
Tapping a tool row expands its detail in place while the rest of the log recedes.

options.label: Ticket Rail
options.lineage: kitchen order tickets clipped on a stainless pass rail
options.thesis: Every turn is a ticket on the rail: fired, cooking, plated — the agent's work reads like a busy pass.
options.viewport: Open sessions hang as tickets on a rail across the top; the current ticket fills the screen with its order number, time, each tool as a line item checked off as it completes, and the reply printed below.
options.risk: My top-ranked and most familiar candidate; tickets carry task status better than long conversational replies.

options.label: Departure Board
options.lineage: rail concourse split-flap boards at rush hour
options.thesis: Sessions are departures: each row flips to its live state and the whole board reads in one gaze.
options.viewport: Session list as ruled board rows with a flipping status column; the chat opens as a single expanded row.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for the session list and live state (holds product clarity); its black board fights your daylight, on-the-move scene.
options.risk: A dark board in sunshine, and long replies don't live in fixed character cells.

options.label: High-Density Modules
options.thesis: Pack far more onto one screen in hairline-ruled modules.
options.viewport: A mosaic of small ruled modules with red tabs.
options.case: Fuses poorly: tiny packed type fails a one-handed glance outdoors.
options.kept: Its hairline-ruled density discipline, now governing the tool log.
options.risk: Unreadable at arm's length in daylight.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles; the focused one grows and explains itself.
options.case: Fuses poorly: there is no artwork to carry it.
options.kept: Focus expands detail in place; tool rows now do this.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1970s pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: One type size; rank carried by weight, case, reversal and rule.
options.viewport: Raked slides along a lit bed.
options.case: Fuses poorly: raked containers cost legibility on a moving phone.
options.kept: One reversed plate per screen, now reserved for what needs you.
options.risk: Raked text is hard to read in motion.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: A ballpoint tracklist timed to the minute.
options.case: Fuses poorly: handwriting slows fast reading of agent output.
options.kept: Running times right-aligned against the margin, now on every tool row.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Everything numbered; colour codes stand in for words.
options.viewport: A numbered index as the only map.
options.case: Fuses poorly: coded labels hide state, breaking 'state is truth'.
options.kept: Strict catalog numbering, now stable channel numbers on sessions.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern AI chat app executed impeccably: bubbles, clean column, one accent.
canonCard.viewport: Top app bar, message bubbles, a pill composer at the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the ChatGPT-style apps you said would feel wrong.
